scripts.lint: pnpm exec biome check . && pnpm exec markdownlint-cli2 "*.md" ".github/*.md" ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**/*.md" "docs/**/*.md" "apps/**/*.md" "jobs/**/*.md" "packages/**/*.md" "scripts/**/*.md" "configs/**/*.md" "infra/**/*.md" "#apps/campus-web/.generated/**" "#**/node_modules/**" && pnpm exec editorconfig-checker -no-color -disable-indentation -disable-indent-size -exclude '(^|/)(dist|node_modules|\.tmp|drizzle/meta)(/|$)'
scripts.docs:check: pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-frontmatter.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-adr-ids.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-links.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-language.ts
scripts.test: pnpm exec tsx --test scripts/ci/*.test.ts scripts/deploy/*.test.ts scripts/dev/*.test.ts scripts/docs/*.test.ts scripts/notices/*.test.ts scripts/release/*.test.ts scripts/release/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm docs:check && pnpm test
scripts.dev: pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev/cli.ts doctor && turbo run dev --env-mode=strict --filter=campus-web --filter=app-api --filter=model-config --filter=execution-control --filter=agent-runtime
